title: WE'LL TARRY BY THE LIVING WATERS292
author: F.E Belden
stanzas: We'll tarry by the living waters, the fountain pure and free; There Jesus waits to give us welcome, a welcome sweet 't will be
We'll tarry by the living waters, (fount of living waters) tarry by the living waters (fount of living waters) Tarry by the living waters (fount of living waters) Tarry by the fount of life
When weary with toilsome journey, 'Tis sweet to rest awhile, Where crystal waters gently murmur, and sunny fountains smile.
Then come to Christ, the kliving water, thy strength will He restore; come, taste the joy of his salvation, And drink to thirst no more.
